verdict.rationale: Aleph is an FP&A platform that advertises reporting automation, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never shows any of these for automations. 'Versioned forecasts' covers financial data scenarios, approving AI mapping suggestions is a review step for agent outputs, and audit logs are a general security control. These are adjacent features that earn no credit toward version history or rollback of automation definitions.
